input: Set a monthly charitable giving goal

gold.taskTitle: Set a Monthly Charitable Giving Goal
gold.taskDescription: Define and commit to a specific monthly dollar amount or percentage of income dedicated to charitable giving.

questions.title: What is your current monthly take-home income?
questions.description: Understanding income helps calibrate a realistic and meaningful giving target.

questions.title: Do you have a specific total dollar amount in mind?
questions.description: Determines whether the user already has a figure or needs help calculating one.

questions.title: Which causes or types of charities matter most to you?
questions.description: Identifies whether the goal is tied to one organization or spread across multiple causes.

questions.title: Are you giving to one charity or splitting across several?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the monthly goal covers a single recipient or a portfolio of donations.

questions.title: Do you want to give a fixed amount or a percentage?
questions.description: Establishes the structure of the goal — flat sum versus income-proportional giving.

questions.title: Have you donated regularly before, or is this a new habit?
questions.description: Context on prior giving history helps set a realistic and sustainable starting point.

questions.title: Do you want to track or automate the donations each month?
questions.description: Determines whether the plan needs to include a tracking system or automatic payment setup.
